relationships.subject: TNF-alpha inhibitors
relationships.evidence_quote: TNF-alpha inhibitors are commonly used as novel therapeutics in AS; however, they can potentially result in serious complications, that is, secondary demyelinating disorders.

key_findings: Case of AQP4-positive NMOSD with longitudinally extensive transverse myelitis in a patient with undiagnosed HLA-B27-positive ankylosing spondylitis.
Patient responded to methylprednisolone and rituximab; TNF-alpha inhibitors were avoided.
